name: The Price of Shoes
summary: Verner Osgood has run out of iron in Lakeshire, where the guard's gear needs constant repair. He sends you west across Elwynn Forest to ask Smith Argus in Goldshire for horseshoes.

sections.title: A Frontier Strained to the Limit
sections.body: Lakeshire faces gnolls, orcs, and murlocs, while Stormwind sends little help. The garrison fights each day to keep the town from falling, and battle quickly wears down its gear. Verner Osgood spends nearly every waking hour repairing dented breastplates, reshaping dulled swords, and keeping the guards clad in iron. The work has exhausted his supply of raw materials.

sections.title: Supply Lines to Elwynn
sections.body: Without iron, even ordinary work in a frontier town can stop. Horses without shoes cannot carry messengers swiftly or haul supplies along Redridge's rocky paths. Verner swallows his pride and sends you west along the Three Corners road to Goldshire. Smith Argus there still has regular access to the kingdom's mineral stores.

faq.q: Why is Verner out of iron?
faq.answer: Lakeshire's guards face constant assaults from hostile wildlife, gnolls, and Blackrock orcs. Verner has used his iron to repair their battered armor and weapons, leaving none for civilian needs.
Smith Argus is Goldshire's blacksmith in Elwynn Forest. His forge has easier access to raw ingots and supplies than frontier towns such as Lakeshire.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire lack supplies from Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormwind's rulers are caught in political inertia while King Varian Wrynn is missing. The House of Nobles withholds troops and funds, leaving frontier towns such as Lakeshire to fend for themselves with whatever regional trade they can muster.

faq.q: Why are horseshoes so critical in Redridge?
faq.answer: Redridge's rocky terrain quickly wears down unshod hooves. Without horseshoes, couriers, supply wagons, and patrol mounts can go lame, cutting Lakeshire off from the rest of the kingdom.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Smith Argus?
faq.answer: Argus accepts Verner's note and gives you horseshoes to carry back to Lakeshire. The town's struggle to hold out continues.

faq.q: Where is Smith Argus located in Goldshire?
faq.answer: Smith Argus works at the outdoor forge near the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, just off Elwynn Forest's main road.

angles.text: A frontier smith must spend scarce materials keeping soldiers alive, leaving little for ordinary farmsteads.
Lakeshire depends on Goldshire for supplies, showing how thinly stretched the kingdom's logistics are under Stormwind's regency.
